Hi arrivals team,
Kennel doors came up earlier this week, so just a quick note from the Companion Animal Travel Desk. Please keep the transfer flow calm and deliberate whenever carriers move from intake to the next service point. We rely on the ground team to handle each enclosure with steady hands, secure latches, and clear verbal checks before any handoff. That small discipline protects the animals and reduces confusion when several services are moving at once.

Please also keep the desk notes practical and brief. If a carrier shows any sign of loosened hardware, damp bedding, or an unsettled pet, flag it at once and pass the concern along without delay. The service works best when each person treats the journey as a shared responsibility rather than a separate task. A short, accurate note is better than a long guess, and it helps the next crew prepare the right care without slowing the line.

Aurelia Skyways depends on dependable companion travel, and that standard is built in routine work, not only in exceptions. Please continue to confirm labels, observe safe spacing, and avoid casual handling that can unsettle the animal inside. If a traveler asks for reassurance, offer it in plain language and keep the explanation factual. The same approach applies whether we are moving a regular kennel or supporting a more nervous pet like Baxter. Thank you for keeping the process orderly and for giving each animal the careful attention it deserves.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
